//: TEMPLATE — committed on purpose, and the reference for every setting this
service reads. It is not loaded by the application: the filename matches no
environment, so ASP.NET Core never picks it up. It exists to be read and copied.
PUT NO REAL VALUE IN THIS FILE. It is tracked by git, so a credential pasted
here is a credential committed.
Which file do I actually edit?
Local, non-secret     appsettings.Development.json  (gitignored)
copy appsettings.Development.example.json to it
Local, sensitive      dotnet user-secrets           (outside the repo)
Container            .env                          (gitignored)
copy .env.example to it
Production           environment variables / Key Vault via managed identity
There are NO credentials below, and that is the design. Every Azure dependency
authenticates with Entra ID through DefaultAzureCredential — managed identity in
Azure, your own az-CLI login locally. No key, connection string, or client secret
exists anywhere in this service.
See CONFIGURATION.md for provider precedence and DEPLOYMENT.md for the RBAC roles.

Chunking.//: Changing these invalidates every chunk already produced — chunk ids derive from position. Treat a change as a corpus rebuild.

Observability.//ServiceVersion: Empty uses the assembly's informational version. Set it from the build pipeline to correlate a latency change with the deployment that caused it.
Observability.//SamplingRatio: 1.0 records every trace. Metrics stay exact at any ratio because they are counted before the sampler runs.

AzureMonitor.//: ConnectionString authorises ingestion, not query. Supply by environment variable or Key Vault — never here.

Otlp.//: A local collector — the Aspire dashboard, Jaeger, a sidecar. Empty disables it. docker-compose sets this.

HealthChecks.//ExposeDetails: Off by default: a detailed body enumerates this service's dependencies and which one is broken, to anyone who can reach the endpoint.

Credential.//: Empty ManagedIdentityClientId = system-assigned identity. Set only for user-assigned. A client id is not a secret.

Storage.//: Account URI, not a connection string. Connection strings embed a key; URIs do not.

Search.//index: Two indexes, two granularities. IndexName is keyed by document; ChunkIndexName is keyed by chunk and answers 'which passages match'.
Search.//hnsw: HnswM and HnswEfConstruction are fixed at index creation; changing them requires a rebuild. HnswEfSearch can be revised in place.
Search.//vectorizer: Service-side Azure OpenAI vectorizer: disabled and not used. The application generates query embeddings itself and submits a VectorizedQuery. See DEPLOYMENT.md.

DocumentIntelligence.//: Empty Endpoint selects the local PdfPig extractor. Set it to enable OCR of scanned documents.

AiFoundry.//: Deployment names, not model names. Using the model name where Azure expects the deployment is the most common cause of a 404 from otherwise correct configuration.
AiFoundry.//ChatTemperature: Omit for reasoning models (gpt-5-mini accepts only its default and returns 400 otherwise). For a non-reasoning model, 0.0.
AiFoundry.//EmbeddingDimensions: Must equal the model's native size (text-embedding-3-large 3072, -3-small 1536); checked at startup for known models. knowledge-chunks is created with it.
AiFoundry.//retry: Owned by Polly; the SDK's own retry is disabled so the two cannot multiply. Shared by embeddings, chat, and the agent — one resource, one quota, one budget.

//: ProjectEndpoint is required: https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>. The account endpoint returns 404 for agent calls, so there is no fallback.
Version is required outside Development. It is verified on first use against this build's
definition fingerprint. Empty (Development only) provisions a matching version on the first
question and logs the number to pin; that needs the Azure AI Project Manager write role.
Temperature: omit for reasoning models, as ChatTemperature.
Agent.Name: knowledge-assistant
Agent.//MaxToolIterations: The hard cost ceiling on one question: how many times the agent may search before it is asked to answer with what it has.
